question: What powers illuminate the world in impure knowledge?
premises: In impure knowledge there is a world radiant with nine Shaktis.
These Shaktis extend up to Manonmani.
They are declared to begin with Vama.
inference: The world of impure knowledge is defined by a ninefold Shakti group from Vama to Manonmani.
plain_english: In impure knowledge there is a world shining with nine Shaktis, beginning with Vama and extending up to Manonmani.
